title: Arena Friends
hook: The smallest 3D Godot game the kit makes: walk and jump in an arena with your friends, each a gf-humanoid-1 body.

round.winBy: nobody wins: it is an arena to share

rules.summary: Walk, run and jump in the arena with your friends. Nothing to win: the round ends when the clock does.

characters.describe: a round jelly bean with arms and legs

build.how: the bean bodies under the starter's own bright light; three's pastel light and materials are not ported yet, so the look judge's sheet is still to make

accept: the game boots from this spec on runtime godot, profile 3d
two players in one room each see the other where they really are
